# Churchill Downs News Release: Unbeaten Hughes, Sire Into Mischief Lead Individual Choices as Kentucky Derby Future Wagers Open Thursday-Sunday


## Nov 22, 2026


Unbeaten Breeders’ Cup Juvenile (Grade I) winner Hughes (6-1) and his sire Into Mischief (4-1) lead the individual morning-line choices for Kentucky Derby Future Wager Pool 2 and the Kentucky Derby Sire Future Wager, which open Thursday at noon (all times Eastern) and close Sunday at 6 p.m.


In Pool 2, the “All Other Colts and Geldings Foaled in 2024” option is the 2-1 overall morning-line favorite among 40 wagering interests, which include 39 individual horses.


Trained by Hall of Famer Bob Baffert, Hughes improved to 5-for-5 with a 2 ¼-length victory in the $2 million Breeders’ Cup Juvenile on Oct. 30 at Keeneland. The race was his third Grade I victory, following wins in the Del Mar Futurity and American Pharoah Stakes.


Among the other top interests in the pool is Team Valor International’s U. S. S. Valor (8-1), the second choice among individual horses. Trained by Hall of Famer Shug McGaughey III, the son of War of Will won the Oct. 3 Champagne (GI) at Belmont Park by 6 ½ lengths following a 13 ¼-length maiden victory at Saratoga. His connections elected to bypass the Breeders’ Cup Juvenile with a potential run in next year’s Kentucky Derby as their ultimate goal.

Overall, there are 14 new individual interests in Pool 2: Ala Sawab, Barrel Roll, Belzoni, Bletchley, Bourbon Neat, Donegal Luster, Election Hero, Hullabaloo Ray Ray, Kivo, Mixit, Ring for Peace, Slade, Speaker’s Speech and Torcello.


The Kentucky Derby Sire Future Wager allows fans to bet on the sire of the Kentucky Derby winner, with 39 individual stallions and an “All Others” option covering the offspring of sires not listed individually.


Into Mischief (4-1), the sire of Kentucky Derby winners Authentic (2020), Mandaloun (2021) and Sovereignty (2025), is the morning-line favorite. Gun Runner (6-1) is the second choice, followed by Not This Time and “All Others,” both at 8-1.

Both pools offer $2 Win and Exacta wagering. Fans can place wagers at simulcast outlets across the country and through advance deposit wagering platforms such as TwinSpires.com, the official wagering platform of Churchill Downs Incorporated and the Kentucky Derby.


Four additional Kentucky Derby Future Wager pools will be offered in 2027: Pool 3 (Jan. 15-17); Pool 4 (Feb. 12-14); Pool 5 (March 12-14) and Pool 6 (April 1-3). For the first time, the Longines Kentucky Oaks Future Wager will be offered twice, running concurrently with Pools 5 and 6.


There are no refunds in the Kentucky Derby Future Wager. If Churchill Downs officials determine while the pool is open that an injury, illness or other circumstance would prevent an individual horse from participating in the Kentucky Derby, wagering on that horse will be suspended immediately.


Additional information, Brisnet.com past performances and real-time odds will be available at www.KentuckyDerby.com.
